errors.ambiguous: More than one source has a snippet named "{name}"; say which one (user, project or local).
errors.bad_args: The snippets plugin got arguments it cannot read: {reason}
errors.budget: Not run: the run in all views took too long, so this view was left out.
errors.code_too_long: The snippet is longer than {limit} characters.
errors.duplicate_name: Another snippet of this source has the same name; only the first one runs.
errors.frame: The view's page has no frame to run the snippet in yet.
errors.header: The snippet's header has a value that does not read: @{tag}.
errors.invalid_snippet: The snippet "{name}" cannot run; the list says why.
errors.library_full: The saved snippets are full ({limit}); delete one first.
errors.no_active_view: No view is active; run the snippet in all views instead.
errors.no_project: No project is open, so nothing can be saved; keep the snippet in Settings > DevTools & Debugging > Snippets instead.
errors.project_untrusted: There is no snippet "{name}" you can run: the project's snippets load only once you trust this workspace.
errors.save_failed: The snippet could not be saved.
errors.save_untrusted: Snippets are saved in the project folder, which needs workspace trust; trust the workspace, or keep the snippet in Settings > DevTools & Debugging > Snippets.
errors.unknown_view: There is no such view any more.

panel.codeHint: JavaScript, the body of an async function: return a value to see it, await works. A header such as // @world main sets the world, target and timeout. Ctrl+Enter runs it.
panel.confirmDelete: Delete the saved snippet "{name}"? Your own and the project's snippets stay.
panel.empty: No snippets yet. Write one below and save it, or add one in Settings > DevTools & Debugging > Snippets.
panel.modified: Changed: runs as written, not saved
panel.name: Name
panel.noProject: No project is open: only your own snippets are listed.
panel.plainLarge: Shown in one colour: larger than 200 KiB.
panel.projectDisabled: The project's snippets are switched off in the settings.
panel.projectUntrusted: The project's snippets (.rbrowser/snippets) are not loaded until you trust this workspace.
panel.running: Running in {count, plural, one {# view} other {# views}}...

defaultTimeoutMs.description: How long a snippet may run in one view, in milliseconds (100 to 9000), unless its header says @timeoutMs. Past it the snippet is stopped and the view stays usable.
defaultTimeoutMs.help: How long a snippet may run in one view, in milliseconds (100 to 9000), unless its header says @timeoutMs; past it the snippet is stopped and the view stays usable.
defaultTimeoutMs.label: Default timeout

defaultWorld.description: Where a snippet runs unless its header says @world: the isolated world (the page's DOM, not its globals; the page cannot see the snippet) or the page's own world (its globals and frameworks).
defaultWorld.help: Where a snippet runs unless its header says @world: isolated sees the page's DOM but not its globals and stays invisible to the page; main sees the page's globals and frameworks.
defaultWorld.label: Default world

library.description: Your own snippets for every project, each a name and its code; they run in any workspace. Not writable over MCP.
library.help: Your own snippets for every project, each a name and its code; they run in any workspace. Example: name Outline images, code document.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(...). Not writable over MCP.
library.label: Your snippets

projectEnabled.description: Lists and runs the project's snippets from .rbrowser/snippets - only in a workspace you trust.
projectEnabled.help: Lists and runs the project's snippets from .rbrowser/snippets, only in a workspace you trust. Off shows your own library only.
projectEnabled.label: Project snippets

tools.list: The snippets: the user's own, the project's (.rbrowser/snippets, only in a trusted workspace) and the saved ones, with name, source, description, world, target and timeout; withCode: true adds the code. Also the views and whether the project's snippets were loaded.
tools.run: Runs a snippet in the targeted views - a stored one by name (and source when two share it) or the given code - and answers one result per distinct value with the views that gave it; errors with their stack, timeouts marked. Only while evaluate over MCP is allowed in the settings.
tools.save: Saves code as a snippet of the project's checkout (.rbrowser/out/snippets), or deletes one with delete: true; only in a trusted workspace and while evaluate over MCP is allowed.
